c1_historical_reconciliation.interpretation: The historical local-adapter evaluation is not bitwise reproduced by the exported merged package. Membership and scoring are not the cause. The remaining difference is inference-artifact/runtime numerical behavior, so fresh package scores and historical scores are reported separately.

limitations: C1's internal validation membership influenced checkpoint and decoding selection, so this is development evidence rather than an independent test.
Direct-pilot training overlap could not be fully audited. This evaluation must not be presented as leakage-free.
The published C1 package does not bitwise reproduce the historical local-adapter predictions; both result sets retain their own inference-path labels.
Automatic BLEU and chrF++ do not establish factual fidelity; names, numbers, dates, and negation remain queued for human review.
